description: Rexa securely connects to the user's own King of the Curve account through OAuth. It helps the connected MCAT learner understand their study snapshot, aggregate subject performance, exam progress, and published KOTC resources. Rexa identifies evidence-backed study priorities and explains recent trends without changing study records or accessing another learner's account.

defaultPrompt: Review my KOTC study snapshot and suggest what to study next.
Show my weakest MCAT areas using my KOTC performance data.
Summarize my recent KOTC exam progress and study priorities.
